summary.headline: Lord of the Seventh in Twelve Places
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the lord of the sixth in each of the twelve places, including medicine, slaves, quadrupeds, siblings, parents, children, travel, princes, and infirmity. Chapter 14 begins the significations of the lord of the seventh in the twelve places, describing contention and enmity involving women, brothers, father, and children.
